question.en: Discuss the role of the International Development Association (IDA) in promoting sustainable development in low-income countries.
question.hi: Discuss the role of the International Development Association (IDA) in promoting sustainable development in low-income countries.

modelAnswer.en: IDA plays a critical role by providing long-term, interest-free credits and grants. It supports infrastructure, healthcare, and education, which are essential for poverty reduction. By targeting the poorest nations, it helps bridge the development gap and fosters global economic stability.
